tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---INITIAL---"; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "---NEW---"; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---COUNTS---"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command:
hops fg create customersa8deb9 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --features "row_id:string:unique record key,name:string,balance_eur:double:balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:epoch milliseconds event time" \
  --description "Customers initial export (original schema)" \
  --json 2>&1
hops fg insert customersa8deb9 --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -30

hops fg create customersa8deb9 --version 2 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --online \
  --features "row_id:string:unique record key,full_name:string:replaces name,balance:double:balance currency varies,currency:string:ISO code,updated_at:bigint:epoch milliseconds event time" \
  --description "Customers full re-export (new breaking schema), online enabled" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -50
tool_input.description: Create feature group v2 with online store

tool_input.command: hops fg insert customersa8deb9 --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25
hops fg info customersa8deb9 --version 2 --json 2>&1 | grep -iE '"online_enabled"|"version"|"name"' | head; echo "===PREVIEW==="; hops fg preview customersa8deb9 --version 2 --json 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Verify v2 metadata and preview rows

tool_input.command: hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids FROM customersa8deb9_2" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Count rows in v2 offline store

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids FROM customersa8deb9_2" --json 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Count rows in v2 with no-verify
